novelty_tier.fingerprint_encoding: 512 lowercase hexadecimal characters interpreted as one big-endian bitset
novelty_tier.similarity: Tanimoto intersection over union on set bits; zero union is 1.0
novelty_tier.reference_self_membership: do not exclude a query ligand_id when that identifier belongs to the source-consistent reference population

assay_policy.assay_size_metric: unique compounds after relation filtering, missing-value removal, and exact duplicate collapse

target_mirroring_policy.pair_evidence_population: source-consistent same-document assay-pair population using shared equality-relation compounds with reported pChEMBL in both assays
target_mirroring_policy.exclusion_policy: an otherwise qualifying validation or test assay incident to one or more target_mirroring pairs has final status target_mirroring_excluded

missing_values.missing_experimental_pchembl: exclude from assay eligibility and performance; do not impute
missing_values.missing_prediction: exclude only from complete-case performance; do not change eligibility or retention

aggregation.correlation: Pearson r on complete experimental-prediction pairs; r2 is r squared
aggregation.split_mean_r2: unweighted arithmetic mean over retained assays with defined r2

release_comparison.scientific_scope: input coverage only; independent of novelty, eligibility, retention, and performance
